purpose: Determine why the E2A direct-head cross-region representation fails strongly for B12/O13 before defining any replacement representation.

physical_scope.hydraulic_family: same base MvG/KSATFIT law as E2A
physical_scope.oracle: same steady-Darcy integral/root law as E2A

fresh_probe_rule.distribution: independent scrambled Sobol in wet h and dry u

wet.coordinate: linear pressure head h in [-1,+1] cm

dry_effective_saturation.coordinate: S uniformly between S(-10000) and S(-1), mapped to h by the exact material inverse
dry_effective_saturation.reason: Ross uses water-content/saturation-type dependent variables in unsaturated regions; this diagnostic tests coordinate conditioning without changing the constitutive law.

precommitted_decomposition: FULL_BILINEAR_LOGM: both wet and dry dimensions interpolated in log mobility
WET_ONLY_LOGM: dry head held exact, interpolate only between adjacent wet nodes
DRY_ONLY_LOGM: wet head held exact, interpolate only between adjacent dry nodes
FULL_BILINEAR_M: same nodes but interpolate positive mobility M directly instead of log(M), diagnostic only
reported_metrics: max and p99 hybrid flux error for each decomposition
max absolute flux error over KSATFIT for each decomposition
per-probe wet-only, dry-only and combined errors
error change under dry log-head node counts 241->481->961
error change from dry u-coordinate to uniform-S coordinate at 241 nodes
error change from logM interpolation to direct-M interpolation

classification_rules.DRY_AXIS_RESOLUTION_DOMINANT: At Nwet=33, p99 DRY_ONLY_LOGM error is at least 10x WET_ONLY_LOGM and p99 FULL_BILINEAR_LOGM decreases by at least 4x from Nu=241 to Nu=961.
classification_rules.DRY_COORDINATE_CONDITIONING_DOMINANT: Uniform-S Nu=241 p99 DRY_ONLY_LOGM is at least 4x lower than log-head Nu=241 while WET_ONLY remains below the frozen E2A p99 threshold.
classification_rules.LOG_MOBILITY_TRANSFORM_DOMINANT: At identical Nu=241/Nwet=33 nodes, direct-M p99 full-bilinear flux error is at least 4x lower than logM.
classification_rules.WET_AXIS_DOMINANT: p99 WET_ONLY_LOGM is at least 10x DRY_ONLY_LOGM for log-head Nu=241.
classification_rules.MIXED_OR_NONSEPARABLE: none of the dominant classifications above is met.

hard_guards: No thresholds from E2A are relaxed.
No result from this diagnostic qualifies a replacement representation.
No physical theta(h) or K(h) law is changed.
No new candidate is selected until this diagnostic result is persisted.
The E2A failure remains authoritative negative evidence.
exit: Persist causal classification and only then freeze a separate E2A-R1 representation contract if evidence supports one.
